hypothesis: Fold-train-only masked sequence reconstruction will initialize V8's learned temporal and normalization-free moment filters with motion structure before supervised fine-tuning, reducing small-sample overfitting without adding any handcrafted signal feature or changing the downstream architecture.
folds: fixed 5 outer contexts x 3 inner validation folds
stop_rule: Use seed 42 as the preregistered discovery run. Replicate with seeds 43 and 44 only if mean balanced accuracy improves by at least 0.01, at least 9 of 15 matched folds improve, and AUROC does not regress by more than 0.01. Retain only if the gain then remains coherent across the three seeds.
